messages.subject: geom="tile" & scale_fill_identity legend disappears
parts:
Hi all,

I'm quite new to the ggplot2 packages, so maybe I've done something
wrong.
I've performed a MonteCarlo simulation with different sampling
fractions in order to evaluate the coverage of a spatial predictor.
I'd like to report the results I've obtained using a tile plot for
each of the sampling fractions. At the same time I'd like that the
range of colors remains the same in each of the plots. Here is the
code I wrote

intervals <- cut(coverage, breaks = c(0:10) / 10, right = T)
col <- rev(heat.colors(10))
p <- qplot(x, y, fill = col[coverage], geom = "tile") +
scale_fill_identity(breaks = col, labels = c("(0, 0.1]", "(0.1, 0.2]",
"(0.2, 0.3]", "(0.3, 0.4]", "(0.4, 0.5]", "(0.5, 0.6]", "(0.6, 0.7]",
"(0.7, 0.8]", "(0.8, 0.9]", "(0.9, 1]"), name = "Coverage", guide =
"legend") + opts(title = "10%")

The problem is that R produces the plot, but no legend appears.

Thanks,
Alessandro
